VIMS (Vendor Invoice Management System): A Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) system is secure online platform, designed to streamline the process of managing invoices from vendors. It ensures efficient invoice capture, approval, and pay ment processing within an organization. The system integrates with enterprise resource planning ( ERP) platforms like SAP to centralize financial data and Government e Market place (GeM Portal). I nvoices from vendors are uploaded with respect to purchase orders and goods receipts and servic es ordered and consumed. It also provides transparency, allowing for better tracking, auditing, and reporting.
